name: ses-lockdown
description: Tether Secure Browser v1.5.0 (Secure Client Attestation v2: replaces v1.4.0's single globally-embedded attestation private key, WITHDRAWN as a critical vulnerability, with a per-installation keypair generated on first need and encrypted at rest via Electron safeStorage, never exported through any application API; adds attestExamSession alongside attestSystemCheck, both purpose-bound and installation-signed)

scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --dir && npm run verify:package
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win && npm run verify:package -- release/win-unpacked
